mechanism.claim: When BTC crosses the midpoint of its completed seven-day auction range while open interest expands over the same completed eight-hour cycle and realized variation is causally elevated, newly built leverage confirms a value-regime migration that persists for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a strict upward prior-range-midpoint crossing; short on a strict downward crossing
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCORR requires exact endpoint OI expansion to confirm a transition through the fixed midpoint of a trailing external high-low range. It uses no funding value or rank and is not HVCFBR's range escape, HVCFRR's funding-tail regime, an OI-return attribution statistic, fitted channel, or prior control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed intervening eight-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 40 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: fixed eight-hour range-midpoint transitions confirmed by exact endpoint OI expansion are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.open_interest: finite positive BTCUSDT period=5m sum_open_interest observations at D-8h and D, each exchange-timestamped no later than D
features.completed_cycle: exact coherent BTCUSDT one-minute OHLC aggregation over [P,S)
features.prior_range: maximum high and minimum low of the 21 uninterrupted completed eight-hour cycles ending at P; the current [P,S) cycle is excluded
features.range_midpoint: arithmetic midpoint of the prior range high and low
features.regime_cross: last close at D-8h at or below midpoint and last close before D strictly above maps long; last close at D-8h at or above midpoint and current close strictly below maps short; exactly one direction required
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns over exactly 480 coherent BTCUSDT bars [D-8h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.eligible: 22 uninterrupted coherent cycles including current, two exact OI endpoints with strict expansion, one strict range-midpoint crossing, and variation rank pass at D; no funding, divergence, premium, alt, or post-decision condition

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.open_interest: Postgres open_interest_binance BTCUSDT period=5m exact endpoint observations
source_plan.bars: Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no OI endpoint or expansion rule, prior-range length, midpoint-cross definition, variation history, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
